items.html: And behold, afterward these Mochin grow more, and it is that these Names of Elokim are filled in the secret of their fillings. And the distinction and difference that there is between one and the other is that the Elokim of Hochma has its filling with Yuds, and that of Bina with Heis, and that of Daat with Alephs. And the mnemonic is YH'A (Yud, Hei, Aleph). As explained by us in the intention of 'Amen, may His great Name be blessed', etc. It thus follows that also in their fillings, all the difference and distinction is only recognizable in the Hei of Elokim. (And it seems to me, Chayim, that this too is in the manner stated above, in the form of the simple Elokim, for the reason is to indicate that only the Mochin of Bina was repaired.)
